description: This Java source file defines the TestRunContainer class, which implements a container for running JUnit tests within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages test initialization, execution, logging, and reporting, including handling test results and generating XML reports.

classes.name: TestRunContainer
classes.description: Implements a container to run JUnit tests, handle test execution, logging, and reporting within the OFBiz framework. Contains inner classes for XML report formatting and test event listening.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container, sets up logging directory, retrieves test properties, and prepares the test suite wrapper.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the test suites, collects results, logs outcomes, and throws exception if any test fails.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the container; no implementation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.

methods.name: setLoggerLevel
methods.description: Sets the debug log level based on user input.

methods.name: prepareJunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Prepares the JunitSuiteWrapper based on test properties; throws exception if no tests found.

methods.name: createJunitXmlListener
methods.description: Creates a JunitXmlListener for XML report generation.

methods.name: logTestSuiteResults
methods.description: Logs summary and detailed errors/failures of test suite results.

methods.name: logErrorsOrFailures
methods.description: Logs individual test failures or errors.
